steps.name: подготовка
steps.js: document.querySelector('.title .btn').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); FB.ui.closeAll(); const S = FB.S; S.tut = 99; S.tips = { chip: 1, profile: 1, bait: 1, bubbles: 1, drift: 1, pl_ducks: 1, see_ducks: 1, top: 1, shop: 1, rods: 1, look: 1, medals: 1, sonar: 1, aqua_btn: 1 }; S.stats.catches = 60; S.luck = 7; S.xp = 1200; S.level = FB.state.levelFromXp(1200); S.coins = 9000; S.pearls = 400; S.owned.push('bt_red', 'fr_fire', 'jk_hawaii', 'hat_captain'); S.look.boat = 'bt_red'; S.look.frame = 'fr_fire'; S.look.jacket = 'jk_hawaii'; S.look.hat = 'hat_captain'; S.who = 'girl'; FB.panels.goTo('village'); FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.setPlace('village', 'sun'); FB.hud.update(); return document.querySelector('.tourney-chip').className;

steps.name: жор и ошибка
steps.js: FB.events.startFrenzy(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) FB.ui.toast(FB.t('too_far'), 'info'); return document.querySelectorAll('.toast').length;

steps.name: итоги недели
steps.js: FB.ui.closeAll(); const idx = FB.state.weekIdx() - 1; const r = { idx, rank: 16, pts: 265, reward: FB.tourney.rewardFor(16) }; FB.S.lastResult = r; FB.catchCard.weekResult(r);

steps.name: рамки
steps.js: FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.shopUI.open('look'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.sheet .tabs')[1].querySelectorAll('.tab'); tabs[6].click();
FB.ui.closeAll(); FB.scene.resize(); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); FB.top.open('anglers'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1200)); document.querySelectorAll('.lb-row')[0].click();
